title: Create the midyear capex funding screen
prompt:
Create a new workbook at:
`Deliverables/CapEx funding screen - 7.2.xlsx`

Create exactly two sheets: `Funding Screen` and `Sources & Controls`. On `Funding Screen`, create a real Excel table named `CapExRequests` in A5:K10 with all five midyear requests and columns for Request ID, Asset, Documented Decision, Request Amount, Approved Amount, Funding, Annual Savings, Simple Payback, Equipment-Line Proceeds, Cash Required, and Finance Classification. Use formulas for payback, financing, and cash required. Put the summary labels in A13:A21 and formula-driven results in B13:B21, in this order: Approved Spend, Approved Annual Savings, Equipment-Line Proceeds, Cash Required, Facility Remaining, AOP Remaining After Approved Requests, Downside Maximum Revolver, Revolver Capacity After Downside, and Pro Forma Leverage. Calculate AOP remaining from the $1.1 million board envelope less January-through-June posted fixed-asset additions and approved request spend. Calculate Pro Forma Leverage using proposed-WIP pro-forma LTM adjusted EBITDA and funded debt plus eligible indicated equipment-line proceeds.

Begin with the capital-allocation request in `Requests/`. Locate the current request schedule and committee memo, board-approved plan workbook and deck, fleet support, indicative financing proposal, downside cash work, executed credit agreement, and posted accounting balances. On `Sources & Controls`, list the actual files and accounting reports used plus formula controls tying the request table to the summary. Include formula controls for the approved-spend total, line-proceeds total, and cash-required total. Apply the same release-now/conditional/hold classifications as the documented approval analysis. Recalculate and save the workbook. Do not overwrite any source file.
